title: Post Soviet Population in Sarasota
text:
The Census Bureau’s B05006 table reports the birthplace of the foreign-born population, not ethnicity or ancestry. The chart compares Sarasota County estimates from three non-overlapping American Community Survey (ACS) five-year periods. It includes countries with a separate B05006 category; some former Soviet republics are not listed separately. Error bars show each estimate’s margin of error (MOE), so small changes should be interpreted cautiously.

library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)

post_soviet_countries <- c(
  "Armenia", "Azerbaijan", "Belarus", "Georgia", "Kazakhstan",
  "Latvia", "Lithuania", "Moldova", "Russia", "Ukraine", "Uzbekistan"
)

years <- c(2013, 2018, 2023)

birthplace_estimates <- map_dfr(years, \(year) {
  country_variables <- load_variables(year, "acs5") |>
    filter(
      str_detect(name, "^B05006_[0-9]{3}$"),
      str_detect(
        label,
        str_c("!!(", str_c(post_soviet_countries, collapse = "|"), ")$")
      )
    ) |>
    select(name, label)

  get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state = "FL",
    county = "Sarasota",
    variables = country_variables$name,
    year = year,
    survey = "acs5"
  ) |>
    left_join(country_variables, by = c("variable" = "name")) |>
    mutate(
      country = str_extract(label, "[^!]+$"),
      year = year
    )
})

ggplot(birthplace_estimates, aes(x = year, y = estimate)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(0, estimate - moe), ymax = estimate + moe),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(country), scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = years) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated Sarasota County residents born in former Soviet republics",
    x = "ACS five-year period ending",
    y = "Estimated residents (error bars = margin of error)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS five-year estimates, table B05006."
  )
